data.value:
YIMA: FUNDA PHAMBI KOKUQHUBEKA
Ukungena kwi- Roblox VNG okokuqala ngqa ufudusa iakhawunti yakho ukuya kwi- VNG . I- Roblox ithi awusayi kuphinda ube nakho ukusebenzisa loo akhawunti kwi-app ye- Roblox yehlabathi.

Qhubeka kuphela ukuba wamkela ukuphulukana nofikelelo lwe-app yehlabathi kuyo nayiphi na iakhawunti oyisebenzisa nge- VNG . Iqhosha lika-Ewe liyavula emva kwemizuzwana elishumi.
